messages:
mina: Quick thread on quota interop for reserved pools + prewarm semantics. Need concise policy to ship this sprint.
ryan: Proposal: per-pool monthly burst credits, per-region buckets, and an opt-in emergency top-up flow.
alberto: Agree. Add carryover cap (15%) and a daily soft-throttle window for heavy users.
jess: For prewarm: gold gets 300s, silver 60s, bronze 0s. Prewarm should consume credits at time of allocation.
mina: Launch criteria: 1) canary with 3 tenants for 48h passing synthetic burst tests, 2) dashboards + alerts in place, 3) billing hooks verified.
ryan: Telemetry to emit: `credits_remaining`, `prewarm_allocs`, `throttle_rate`, `rejects`. Add `estimated_cost` for UI.
alberto: Ops guardrail: max_scale_events_per_min=6 and cooldown after downscale=10m. Emergency top-ups require manual approve.
ops-bot: Ticket RES-2101 created, canary default 48h, rollback trigger `unexpected_throttles > 1.5%`.
mina: OK I'll draft SLA snippets and assign action items in the ticket.
